_note.purpose: Preferred dependency/image choices per role for the dev-env-setup agent system. Scaffold agents read this for context when stubbing out microservices.
_note.version_contract: A version value of "latest" is an INSTRUCTION, not a value to write. At scaffold time the agent resolves "latest" to the newest secure, stable, well-supported release, WRITES that concrete pinned version into the project manifest (package.json, go.mod, requirements.txt, k8s image tag, etc.), and records the resolution in .dev-env/resolved-stack.lock.json. Never leave the literal string "latest" in a project manifest. Pinned exact versions only: no "^", no "~", no floating ranges (SecurityPolicies). If a concrete version is given here instead of "latest", honor it exactly.
_note.audit_gate: After resolving Node dependencies, run `npm audit --audit-level=high` and refuse to proceed on high/critical findings.
_note.container_policy: All images run as non-root. Secrets are injected via env, never baked into images or committed.
_note.lockfile: .dev-env/resolved-stack.lock.json is the shared source of truth for resolved versions across parallel agents and re-runs.

go.notes: Prefer distroless non-root runtime image. Multi-stage build.

node.notes: TypeScript strict mode. Non-root node user. npm ci with committed package-lock.json.

socket-api.description: Optional second API service dedicated to a socket layer. Uses the same language choice as the primary API.

node.notes: One example socket handler + a /healthz route.

go.notes: One example socket handler + a /healthz route.

next.notes: App Router. Server Components by default. shadcn/ui + Tailwind on demand. Non-root.

react.notes: Vite + React + TypeScript strict. shadcn/ui + Tailwind on demand. Non-root.

postgres.vectorNote: Use the pgvector image and enable the `vector` extension in the migrations stub only when vector support is requested.
postgres.migrations: Provide a migrations/ stub directory with an initial 0001_init.sql placeholder.
postgres.secrets: POSTGRES_PASSWORD injected via env / k8s secret, never committed.

mysql.note: Only when explicitly chosen over the Postgres default.

mongodb.note: Only when explicitly chosen over the Postgres default.

rabbitmq.notes: Use the management-enabled tag when resolving. Broker for Celery when Celery is selected.

redis.notes: Non-root. AOF persistence optional in dev.

celery.notes: Own Tilt service with one example task. Requires RabbitMQ (auto-added if Celery selected).

cron.notes: Bare-bones k8s CronJob stub running one placeholder job. OTLP-wired.

otel-collector.notes: Receives OTLP (grpc 4317 / http 4318) from all services; exports traces to Jaeger and metrics to Prometheus.

jaeger.notes: Trace backend + UI. Collector exports traces here.

prometheus.notes: Scrapes the collector's Prometheus exporter endpoint.

grafana.notes: Pre-provisioned datasources for Prometheus and Jaeger.

nginx.notes: Mostly-empty base config with security headers; route blocks are appended per service by des-integration. Per-origin CORS, never wildcard-with-credentials (SecurityPolicies).
